text:
The evidence does not establish whether forest is still being cleared today.

It confirms about 81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss on the property in 2021. Most of that area—68.1 hectares—was mapped as planted pine forest. The loss could reflect plantation harvesting or another cause; it does not by itself establish clearing or permanent land-use change.

Although the satellite series extends through 2025, the evidence provided does not report whether any loss occurred after 2021.
